answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake and keep a verifiable activity pulse: periodic signed proofs of real completed work, checked against its history. A whisper of fake traffic earns nothing, because rewards only follow attested work. Creating thousands of identities then means locking stake for each one and sustaining real work on the ledge of profitability, so a Sybil farm pays more in stake, compute, and time than it can ever extract.
